name: rich-text-field
description: A labeled editor that gives rich text as a tree of typed nodes.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: edit-type
parts.description: Choices for the type of edit.

parts.name: format
parts.description: Format button and its pressed state. Each button is 44 by 44 CSS pixels. Each heading button name starts with its visible glyph.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: Symbol on a format button or link control.

parts.name: input
parts.description: Editable text and its focus ring.

parts.name: link-apply
parts.description: Button that applies the link. It shows a check by default.

parts.name: link-cancel
parts.description: Button that closes the link editor without applying a link. It shows a cross by default.

parts.name: link-editor
parts.description: Address input and controls for a link.

parts.name: link-tooltip
parts.description: Name of a link icon control on hover or focus. Escape closes it.

parts.name: problem
parts.description: Reason that a field value is invalid.

parts.name: reason
parts.description: Reason for a refusal or an edit error.

parts.name: status
parts.description: Result of an edit that the editor cannot accept.

parts.name: tooltip
parts.description: Format name shown on hover or focus. Escape closes the tooltip. The event stops only if the tooltip is open and the focus is in the toolbar.
